prohibited_zone_types: commercial zones (no new Type B permits as of late 2024)
regulations.occupancy_limits: 5 overnight guests (Type A); varies for Type B
regulations.notes: Portland requires STRs to be in the host's primary residence (owner-occupancy required). Type A permits allow 1-2 bedrooms, max 5 overnight guests. Type B conditional use allows 3-5 bedrooms. As of October 2024, new Type B permits are no longer allowed in commercial/industrial zones. Enforcement has intensified — in March 2024, Portland asked Airbnb to remove 100+ listings lacking valid permit numbers.
